definition_zh: 成比例的；相称的；按比例分配的；（数学）比例的；（选举）比例代表制的；适度的
definition_en: changing in step with something else, so that the relation between the two amounts stays the same
core_image: 两个水柱一起升降，刻度始终停在同一条斜线上
scene: 各地区的投入与产出大致成正比。 Investment and output in each region are roughly proportional to one another.
sceneCN: 这里 proportional 是「与……相称的」（第 6 个义项：处罚与造成的损害成比例）；句意：罚款与该公司对河流造成的损害相称。图中可辨识物件：天平两端、按同一斜率升降的两根柱子；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 成比例的；相称的；按比例分配的；比例代表制的

derivatives.zh: 不成比例的；过大或过小的

senses.title: Changing together at a fixed rate
senses.definition: increasing or decreasing at a rate that keeps a constant relation with another quantity
senses.definitionCN: 以与另一数量保持恒定关系的速率增减
senses.example: Pressure is proportional to depth, so it doubles when the depth doubles.
senses.exampleCN: 压力与深度成正比，因此深度加倍时压力也加倍。
senses.why: Pro portione meant 'according to the share'. When two quantities keep their shares aligned, each change in one is matched by a fixed change in the other.
senses.whyCN: pro portione 意为“按份额”。当两个数量保持份额对齐时，一个量的每次变化都由另一个量的固定变化来配平。

senses.title: In due balance
senses.definition: having parts of a size that suits one another and the whole
senses.definitionCN: 各部分大小彼此相称、也与整体相称
senses.example: The architect chose a proportional height for the columns to keep the hall calm.
senses.exampleCN: 建筑师为柱子选了相称的高度，让大厅显得沉稳。
senses.why: The same shares idea applies to parts of a design: a proportional building has no part that looks too big or too small for the rest.
senses.whyCN: 同一个“份额”观念适用于设计的各部分：比例恰当的建筑，没有哪一部分相对其余显得过大或过小。

senses.title: Mathematical proportion
senses.titleCN: 数学意义上的比例关系
senses.definition: describing quantities whose ratio is constant, or a term in that relation
senses.definitionCN: 指比值恒定的量，或处于该关系中的项
senses.example: In the table, the two columns are proportional, with each entry twice the one beside it.
senses.exampleCN: 表中两列成比例，每一条目都是旁边那一条的两倍。
senses.why: Mathematics fixed the word to the constant ratio. A proportional relation is one where doubling one side always doubles the other.
senses.whyCN: 数学把词固定到恒定比值上：成比例的关系，就是一边加倍时另一边必然加倍。

senses.title: Seats shared by vote share
senses.definition: of an electoral system: allocating seats in rough proportion to the votes each party wins
senses.definitionCN: 指按各党所得选票的比例分配议席的选举制度
senses.example: Under proportional representation, a party with a fifth of the vote gains about a fifth of the seats.
senses.exampleCN: 在比例代表制下，得票五分之一的政党约获得五分之一的席位。
senses.why: Electoral reformers borrowed the arithmetic of shares: seats should follow votes as closely as the two columns in a proportional table.
senses.whyCN: 选举改革者借用了份额的算术：席位应尽可能贴着选票走，就像比例表里的两列。

senses.title: Punishment that matches the harm
senses.definition: of a penalty or response: of a size that fits the wrong done or the risk created
senses.definitionCN: 指处罚或回应的大小与过错或造成的风险相称
senses.example: Judges aim for a sanction proportional to the seriousness of the offence.
senses.exampleCN: 法官力求制裁与罪行的严重程度相称。
senses.why: Here proportion is moral rather than numerical: the response should weigh the same as the harm on some shared scale.
senses.whyCN: 这里的比例是道德性的而非数字性的：回应应在某种共同标尺上与损害等重。

senses.title: Scaled to fit
senses.definition: enlarged or reduced so that every part keeps its original relation to the others
senses.definitionCN: 放大或缩小后各部分仍保持原有相互关系
senses.example: The model is proportional to the bridge but only one fiftieth of its length.
senses.exampleCN: 这个模型与那座桥成比例，但长度只有其五十分之一。
senses.why: Anything scaled proportionally keeps every ratio intact. Only one measurement changes; all the others follow it exactly.
senses.whyCN: 任何等比缩放都保留全部比值，只改变一个尺寸，其余尺寸精确跟随。

senses.title: Shared out by shares
senses.definition: divided among people or groups according to an agreed share rather than equally
senses.definitionCN: 按约定份额而非平均地分给人或群体
senses.example: The profits were proportional to each partner's investment.
senses.exampleCN: 利润按每位合伙人的出资比例分配。
senses.why: Distribution is the oldest share sense: each claimant receives the fraction that belongs to them, no more and no less.
senses.whyCN: 分配是最古老的份额义：每个索取者得到属于自己的那一份，不多也不少。

senses.title: Sampled at the same rate
senses.definition: of a sample or statistics: drawn or weighted so that each subgroup appears in its true share
senses.definitionCN: 指抽样或加权使各子群按其真实份额出现
senses.example: The survey used a proportional sample so that rural districts were not undercounted.
senses.exampleCN: 这项调查采用按比例抽样，以免农村地区被少算。
senses.why: Statistics repeats the share logic: if a group is a third of the population, a proportional sample makes it a third of the respondents.
senses.whyCN: 统计学重复份额逻辑：如果某群体占人口三分之一，按比例抽样就让它占受访者的三分之一。

intro.en: Proportional goes back to the Latin phrase pro portione, 'according to the share'. Portio meant a portion or allotted part, and the derived noun proportio named the relation between shares. Late Latin added the adjective proportionalis, which passed through French into English.
intro.cn: proportional 可回溯到拉丁短语 pro portione“按份额”。portio 意为一份或分得的部分，派生名词 proportio 命名各份之间的关系。晚期拉丁语再加形容词 proportionalis，经法语进入英语。

items.en: Portio meant 'a share, a part assigned'. It is the noun that carries the whole idea of dividing something into due parts.
items.cn: portio 意为“份额、分得的部分”。正是这个名词承载了把某物分成应得各份的整个观念。

items.en: The phrase meant 'according to the share'. Cicero and later writers used it for relations in which each part receives its due amount.
items.cn: 这个短语意为“按份额”。西塞罗及后来的作者用它指每一部分各得其应有数量的关系。

items.en: The phrase hardened into the noun proportio, 'comparative relation, analogy'. It covered both arithmetic ratios and fitting arrangement.
items.cn: 这个短语凝固成名词 proportio“比较关系、类比”，既涵盖算术比值，也涵盖恰当的排列。

items.en: Late Latin built the adjective proportionalis from proportio. French proportionnel then supplied the English form in the 16th century.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语由 proportio 造出形容词 proportionalis，法语 proportionnel 随后在 16 世纪提供了英语形式。

items.en: The growth of algebra and geometry fixed proportional to the constant-ratio sense, giving the precise phrase directly proportional.
items.cn: 代数与几何的发展把 proportional 固定到恒定比值义，产生了精确说法“成正比的”。

items.en: Proportional representation was debated from the mid-19th century, and sampling theory made proportional allocation a standard statistical tool.
items.cn: 比例代表制自 19 世纪中叶起被讨论，抽样理论则使按比例分配成为标准统计工具。

note.en: The look-alike group separates proportional from proportion, the adverb and the near-twin proportionate. The meaning group contrasts matching rates, matching sizes and matching shares.
note.cn: 形近组区分 proportional 与名词 proportion、副词及近似的 proportionate；词义组比较“比率相配”“大小相配”与“份额相配”。

entries.definition: a share or a relation between parts. It is the base noun, while proportional is the adjective built on it.
entries.definitionCN: 份额或各部分之间的关系。它是基础名词，proportional 是由它构成的形容词。

entries.definition: in a way that follows a proportion. It tells how something changes or is divided.
entries.definitionCN: 按比例地。它说明某物如何变化或如何分配。

entries.definition: of a size that fits or is fair. It often shades toward suitability, while proportional leans toward arithmetic.
entries.definitionCN: 大小合适或公平的。它常偏向“适宜”，而 proportional 偏向算术。

entries.definition: a statement or an offer. It looks close but comes from pro- plus ponere 'to put', not from portio 'share'.
entries.definitionCN: 陈述或提议。它看起来相近，却来自 pro- 加 ponere“放置”，而非 portio“份额”。

entries.definition: corresponding in size or degree, often with a note of fairness. It is the usual word for a fitting response.
entries.definitionCN: 在大小或程度上相对应的，常含公平意味。它是“恰当回应”的常用词。

entries.definition: equal in measure to something, as of pay and responsibility. It stresses matching a standard.
entries.definitionCN: 在尺度上与某物相当，如薪酬与责任。它强调与某一标准相配。

entries.definition: considered in relation to something else. It says a comparison exists, not that the ratio is fixed.
entries.definitionCN: 相对于某物来考虑的。它只说明存在比较，不说明比值固定。

entries.definition: matching or analogous in position or function. It pairs items without implying a fixed ratio.
entries.definitionCN: 在位置或功能上对应或类似的。它配对项目，但不暗示固定比值。

normalIntro.en: These hooks tie the word to the Latin share, then let the same idea run through ratios, design, elections, penalties, models, profits and samples.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩把词系在拉丁“份额”上，再让同一观念贯穿比值、设计、选举、处罚、模型、利润与抽样。

normal.en: Split it as pro + portion + al: according to the share. Proportional means the shares stay aligned.
normal.cn: 拆成 pro + portion + al：按份额。proportional 意为份额保持对齐。

normal.en: Picture two water columns rising together: the line between their tops always has the same slope.
normal.cn: 想象两根水柱一起上升：柱顶连线始终是同一条斜线。

normal.en: A proportional model bridge fits in your hand because every length was cut by the same fraction.
normal.cn: 比例模型桥能放进手心，因为每条长度都被同一个分数缩小了。

normal.en: Proportional representation hands out seats in the same fractions as votes.
normal.cn: 比例代表制按与选票相同的分数发放席位。

normal.en: A proportional fine weighs the harm on one pan and the penalty on the other until they balance.
normal.cn: 相称的罚款把损害放在天平一端、处罚放在另一端，直到平衡。

abstract.en: Keep 'proportion' as the noun in mind: proportional is simply the adjective that says the shares agree.
abstract.cn: 心里记住 proportion 是名词：proportional 只是说各份额一致的那个形容词。

abstract.en: Notice the double life: in maths the ratio is exact, in law and design it is judged rather than measured.
abstract.cn: 注意它的双重生活：数学里比值是精确的，法律与设计里则是靠判断而非测量。

abstract.en: Ask 'proportional to what?' Every sense needs a second term: another quantity, a harm, a whole, a population.
abstract.cn: 随时问“与什么成比例？”每个义项都需要第二项：另一个数量、一项损害、一个整体、一个人口。

examples.en: The brightness of a lamp is inversely proportional to the square of the distance.
examples.cn: 灯的亮度与距离的平方成反比。

examples.en: The council adopted a proportional system for allocating seats on the new board.
examples.cn: 议会通过了新理事会席位的比例分配制。

examples.en: Analysts expect a proportional rise in shipping costs as fuel prices climb.
examples.cn: 分析师预计运费将随燃料价格上升而成比例上涨。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音“扑罗破身呢”：两样东西一起破、一起补，破口大小始终成比例。

root: 拉丁 pro portione“按份额”，portio 意为“份额、分得的部分”，派生 proportio 与 proportionalis；核心是“两份按同一比率增减”。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses ask the same question: do the shares still line up? Quantities, columns, seats, penalties, models, profits and samples are proportional when each part keeps the fraction it is supposed to have.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项问的都是同一个问题：各份还对得齐吗？数量、表格列、席位、处罚、模型、利润与样本之所以成比例，是因为每一份都保住了它应有的分数。

core.en: Two or more parts keep a constant relation, so when one changes the others change by the same fraction.
core.cn: 两个或更多部分保持恒定关系，于是一个变化时其余按同一分数变化。

branches.en: QUANTITIES: the ratio between two amounts never shifts.
branches.cn: 数量：两个量之间的比值从不移动。

branches.en: SHAPE: design and models keep every part in its original relation.
branches.cn: 形状：设计与模型让每一部分保持原有关系。

branches.en: ALLOCATION: votes, seats and profits follow the agreed fractions.
branches.cn: 分配：选票、席位与利润遵循约定分数。

branches.en: JUSTICE: the response is weighed against the harm.
branches.cn: 公正：回应与损害放在同一杆秤上衡量。

branches.en: SAMPLING: each subgroup appears in its true share.
branches.cn: 抽样：每个子群按真实份额出现。

intro.en: Proportional is pro + portio + -al. The items below follow the same share noun into adverb, verb, near-synonym and negation.
intro.cn: proportional 由 pro、portio 与 -al 构成。下列条目沿着同一个“份额”名词，走到副词、动词、近义词与否定形式。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries give the share noun and the phrase that became a noun. They explain why proportion, proportional and proportionate all point back to one allotment.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语条目给出“份额”名词与凝固成名词的短语，解释为什么 proportion、proportional 与 proportionate 都指向同一次分配。

items.meaning: changing in a fixed relation to something else
items.example: The tax is proportional to the value of the land.
items.exampleCN: 税额与土地价值成比例。

items.meaning: a share; the relation between parts
items.meaningCN: 份额；各部分之间的关系
items.example: The proportion of women in the field is rising.
items.exampleCN: 该领域中女性的比例正在上升。

items.example: Costs were shared proportionally among the members.
items.exampleCN: 费用由成员按比例分摊。

items.example: The reply was proportionate to the threat.
items.exampleCN: 这一回应与威胁程度相称。

items.meaning: the quality of being in due proportion
items.example: Lawyers debated the proportionality of the sentence.
items.exampleCN: 律师争论该判决是否相称。

items.meaning: out of proportion; too large or too small
items.meaningCN: 不成比例的；过大或过小的
items.example: The punishment was disproportionate to the error.
items.exampleCN: 这项处罚与过失不相称。

items.structure: proportionate used as a verb form
items.example: Benefits were proportionated to working hours.

items.meaning: able to be brought into proportion
items.meaningCN: 可与之相称的；可成比例的
items.example: The two budgets are proportionable if the scope is cut.
items.exampleCN: 如果削减范围，两份预算可以相称。

definition_zh: 在……之中；在……中间；伴随……发生
definition_en: in the middle of a situation, group, or place, especially one full of activity or difficulty
core_image: 欢呼的人群中央，那个人安静地站着
scene: 会场里掌声不断，她走上台接过奖杯，脸上却没太多表情。 She accepted the award amid loud applause.
sceneCN: 这里 amid 是「在……之中」（第 1 个义项：某事在另一种情形或氛围当中发生）；句意是她在热烈掌声中接过奖项。

derivatives.zh: 介词：在……之中，amid 的变体
介词：在……中间，是 amid 的词根成分

senses.title: In the middle of an event
senses.definition: while something else is happening around the subject, often something noisy, tense, or difficult
senses.definitionCN: 在主语周围正发生另一件事时，常指喧闹、紧张或困难的局面
senses.example: She accepted the award amid loud applause.
senses.exampleCN: 她在热烈掌声中接过奖项。
senses.why: The word is a worn form of on middan, 'in the middle', so amid places an event inside the surrounding circumstances rather than merely near them.
senses.whyCN: 这个词是 on middan「在中间」的磨损形式，所以 amid 把事件放进周围的情境之内，而不只是在其附近。

senses.title: Surrounded by things
senses.definition: surrounded by physical things or people, used in a slightly literary way
senses.definitionCN: 四周是具体的事物或人，带一点书面色彩
senses.example: The cottage stands amid tall pine trees.
senses.exampleCN: 小屋立在高大的松树之间。
senses.why: The older spatial sense survives in descriptions of landscape, where amid simply means the subject is enclosed by what surrounds it.
senses.whyCN: 较早的空间义保留在景物描写中，此时 amid 只表示主体被周围事物围在中间。

intro.en: Amid is a worn-down Old English phrase meaning 'in the middle'.
intro.cn: amid 是古英语短语「在中间」磨损后的形式。

items.en: on meant 'in, on', and it weakened to a- in several English words.
items.cn: on 意为「在……上、在……里」，在若干英语词中弱化为 a-。

items.en: middan meant 'the middle', related to modern middle and mid.
items.cn: middan 意为「中间」，与现代 middle、mid 相关。

items.en: The phrase meant 'in the middle of', used of place and of company.
items.cn: 这一短语意为「在……中间」，既用于地点也用于人群。

items.en: The phrase fused into amidde, and the final -e was later lost.
items.cn: 短语合并为 amidde，词尾 -e 后来脱落。

items.en: Modern amid is mainly literary and often introduces circumstances rather than physical space.
items.cn: 现代 amid 主要用于书面语，常引出情境而不是具体空间。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the middle root; the near-meaning group compares prepositions of setting.
note.cn: 形近组共享「中间」词根；近义组比较表示所处情境的介词。

entries.definition: the same word with an extra -st
entries.definitionCN: 多一个 -st 的同义变体

entries.definition: surrounded by or included in a group

normalIntro.en: Amid is on mid: right in the middle.
normalIntro.cn: amid 就是 on 加 mid：正在中间。

normal.en: Middle and mid share the same root.
normal.cn: middle 与 mid 同根。

normal.en: Amid usually introduces a situation, not a list.
normal.cn: amid 通常引出情境，而不是列举。

normal.en: Amidst is the longer, older-sounding variant.
normal.cn: amidst 是更长、更古旧的变体。

normal.en: Amid applause means while people clap.
normal.cn: amid applause 意为在掌声当中。

normal.en: Stress the second syllable: a-MID.
normal.cn: 重音在第二个音节：a-MID。

abstract.en: Picture one still figure inside a cheering crowd.
abstract.cn: 想象欢呼人群中一个安静的身影。

abstract.en: See a cottage ringed by pines.
abstract.cn: 想象被松树围住的小屋。

abstract.en: Hear news arriving while a crisis is going on.
abstract.cn: 想象危机进行中传来的消息。

examples.en: The mayor resigned amid growing criticism.
examples.cn: 在越来越多的批评声中，市长辞职了。

examples.en: The village lies amid rolling hills.
examples.cn: 村庄坐落在起伏的丘陵之间。

examples.en: Amid the noise, I could barely hear her.
examples.cn: 在嘈杂声中，我几乎听不见她说话。

dict_mnemonic.text: a 加 mid（中间）：处在中间，就是「在……之中」。

root: 源自古英语短语 on middan「在中间」，middan 与现代 middle、mid 同源；短语合并为 amidde，后失去词尾 -e 成为 amid，现代多用于引出情境，带书面色彩。

sensesIntro.en: The spatial middle comes first, then the same position inside events and circumstances.
sensesIntro.cn: 先有空间上的「中间」，再由同样的位置引申到事件与情境之中。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one still figure at the centre of a crowd.
core.cn: 核心意象：人群正中央一个安静的身影。

branches.en: an award received during applause
branches.cn: 掌声中领奖

branches.en: a resignation during criticism
branches.cn: 批评声中辞职

branches.en: a voice lost in noise
branches.cn: 嘈杂中听不清的声音

branches.en: a cottage among pines
branches.cn: 松林间的小屋

branches.en: a village among hills
branches.cn: 丘陵间的村庄

intro.en: A Germanic preposition built on the word for middle.
intro.cn: 这是建立在「中间」一词上的日耳曼介词。

latinIntro.en: The elements are Germanic, so the Latin list is empty.
latinIntro.cn: 成分属于日耳曼语，因此拉丁词条留空。

definition_zh: 忍受；忍耐；持续
definition_en: to suffer something difficult patiently, or to continue to exist for a long time
core_image: 暴风雪里，一棵老树弯下腰却没有折断
scene: 她忍受了漫长而寒冷的冬天。 She endured the long, cold winter.
sceneCN: 这里 endure 是「忍受」（第 1 个义项：耐心承受痛苦或困难）；句意：她忍受了漫长而寒冷的冬天。

senses.title: To bear something difficult
senses.definition: to suffer pain, hardship, or an unpleasant situation patiently
senses.definitionCN: 耐心承受疼痛、艰苦或不愉快的处境
senses.example: She endured the long, cold winter.
senses.exampleCN: 她忍受了漫长而寒冷的冬天。
senses.why: The Latin root means to harden, so enduring is standing firm under pressure.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根意为变硬，因此忍受就是在压力下站稳。

senses.title: To last or continue
senses.definition: to continue to exist or remain strong over time
senses.definitionCN: 随着时间继续存在或保持稳固
senses.example: The old bridge has endured for centuries.
senses.exampleCN: 这座老桥已经屹立了几个世纪。
senses.why: What hardens against wear can also last, so the word shifts from bearing to surviving.
senses.whyCN: 能抗住磨损的事物也能长久存在，因此词义从承受转向存续。

intro.en: Endure comes from Latin indurare, to harden, through Old French endurer.
intro.cn: endure 来自拉丁语 indurare（使变硬），经古法语 endurer 进入英语。

items.en: Indurare means to make hard or to last.
items.cn: indurare 意为使变硬、持续。

items.en: Endurer means to bear or suffer.
items.cn: endurer 意为承受、忍受。

items.en: English borrows endure with both bearing and lasting senses.
items.cn: 英语借入 endure，兼具忍受与持续两义。

items.en: Endure becomes common for pain, hardship, and time.
items.cn: 在近代早期，endure 常用于疼痛、艰苦与时间。

items.en: The word still joins patient suffering with lasting strength.
items.cn: 现代英语中，这个词仍把耐心承受与持久力量结合在一起。

note.en: Endure bears pain over time; tolerate is more neutral, and last stresses continuing to exist.
note.cn: endure 长期承受痛苦，tolerate 更中性，last 强调继续存在。

entries.definition: to accept something unpleasant without protest

normalIntro.en: Endure is to harden yourself under pain and to keep standing over time.
normalIntro.cn: endure 是在痛苦中让自己变硬，并随时间继续站立。

normal.en: She endured the cold winter.
normal.cn: 她忍受了寒冷冬天。

normal.en: The bridge has endured for centuries.
normal.cn: 这座桥屹立了几个世纪。

normal.en: Endurance is the ability to endure.
normal.cn: endurance 是忍受的能力。

normal.en: Enduring value lasts a long time.
normal.cn: enduring value 持续很久。

normal.en: Some pain is hard to endure.
normal.cn: 有些痛苦难以忍受。

abstract.en: Picture an old tree bending in a storm.
abstract.cn: 想象老树在暴风雪中弯腰。

abstract.en: See a stone bridge worn smooth by time.
abstract.cn: 想象被时间磨得光滑的石桥。

abstract.en: Think of a rope holding under heavy weight.
abstract.cn: 想象绳子在重压下坚持。

examples.en: She endured the long, cold winter.
examples.cn: 她忍受了漫长而寒冷的冬天。

examples.en: The old bridge has endured for centuries.
examples.cn: 这座老桥已经屹立了几个世纪。

examples.en: Some pain is hard to endure.
examples.cn: 有些痛苦难以忍受。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因丢尔」——再苦也不肯「丢」下自己；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 indurare（使变硬），经古法语 endurer 进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: The word covers bearing hardship patiently and continuing to exist over time.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词涵盖耐心承受艰苦，以及随时间继续存在。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an old tree bending but not breaking in a storm.
core.cn: 核心意象：老树在暴风雪中弯曲却不断。

branches.en: The base sense is bearing pain or hardship.
branches.cn: 基本义是承受痛苦或艰苦。

branches.en: What bears wear also continues to exist.
branches.cn: 能承受磨损的事物也继续存在。

branches.en: Patience and durability grow from the same hardness.
branches.cn: 耐心与耐久来自同一种坚硬。

branches.en: The -ance noun names the strength to bear.
branches.cn: -ance 名词命名承受的力量。

branches.en: Enduring things outlast their makers.
branches.cn: 持久的事物比制造者活得更久。

intro.en: Endure is built on the Latin root dur, meaning hard or lasting.
intro.cn: endure 建立在拉丁词根 dur 上，意为坚硬、持久。

latinIntro.en: Durare, to last, also gives durable and duration.
latinIntro.cn: durare（持续）也构成 durable 与 duration。

items.exampleCN: 前缀 en- 进入 endure。

items.example: The root dur- hides inside endure.
items.exampleCN: 词根 dur- 藏在 endure 里。

items.example: To endure is to become hard.

definition_zh: 温室；花房；温室效应的
definition_en: a glass building for growing plants
core_image: 阳光透过玻璃屋顶照在番茄藤上
scene: 温室里的番茄长得很快。 The tomatoes grow fast in the greenhouse.
sceneCN: 这里 greenhouse 是「温室」（第 1 个义项）；句意：温室里的番茄长得很快。

senses.title: A glass house for plants
senses.definition: a glass building used to grow plants
senses.definitionCN: 用来种植植物的玻璃建筑
senses.example: The tomatoes grow fast in the greenhouse.
senses.exampleCN: 温室里的番茄长得很快。
senses.why: The physical building is the core sense.
senses.whyCN: 实际建筑是这个词的核心义。

senses.title: A plant house
senses.definition: a heated house for flowers and tender plants
senses.definitionCN: 培育花卉与娇嫩植物的暖房
senses.example: Orchids fill the greenhouse in winter.
senses.exampleCN: 冬天，兰花摆满了花房。
senses.why: The building is named for what grows inside.
senses.whyCN: 建筑因其中生长的植物而得名。

senses.title: Trapping heat
senses.definition: used before nouns about trapped planetary heat
senses.definitionCN: 用于修饰行星热量被截留的相关名词
senses.example: We must cut greenhouse gas emissions.
senses.exampleCN: 我们必须减少温室气体排放。
senses.why: The glass house becomes an image for the planet.
senses.whyCN: 玻璃房成了整个星球的比喻。

intro.en: Greenhouse joins green with house for a plant building.
intro.cn: greenhouse 由 green 与 house 组合而成，指种植物之屋。

items.en: Grene meant green.
items.cn: grene 意为绿色的。

items.en: Hus meant house.
items.cn: hus 意为房屋。

items.en: Greenhouse named a glass house for plants.
items.cn: greenhouse 指种植物用的玻璃房。

items.en: The glass trapped heat like a garden shed.
items.cn: 玻璃像园中棚屋一样截留热量。

items.en: Greenhouse effect borrowed the image for the planet.
items.cn: 温室效应把这个意象借给了整个星球。

note.en: Greenhouse is compared with look-alike words and words for plant buildings.
note.cn: 把 greenhouse 与形近词以及表示植物房舍的词作比较。

entries.definition: a seller of fruit and vegetables

normalIntro.en: Greenhouse is a house that keeps spring inside.
normalIntro.cn: greenhouse 就是把春天关在里面的房子。

normal.en: The greenhouse is warm inside.
normal.cn: 温室里很暖和。

normal.en: They grow roses in the greenhouse.
normal.cn: 他们在温室里种玫瑰。

normal.en: The greenhouse has a glass roof.
normal.cn: 温室有玻璃屋顶。

normal.en: Greenhouse gases trap heat.
normal.cn: 温室气体截留热量。

normal.en: We visited the greenhouse at the garden.
normal.cn: 我们参观了花园里的温室。

abstract.en: A greenhouse keeps a season from leaving.
abstract.cn: 温室，把一个季节留住。

abstract.en: Glass lets light in and keeps warmth near.
abstract.cn: 玻璃放进光，把暖留住。

abstract.en: The planet is becoming a greenhouse of our making.
abstract.cn: 地球正在变成我们亲手造的温室。

examples.en: The tomatoes grow fast in the greenhouse.
examples.cn: 温室里的番茄长得很快。

examples.en: Orchids fill the greenhouse in winter.
examples.cn: 冬天，兰花摆满了花房。

examples.en: We must cut greenhouse gas emissions.
examples.cn: 我们必须减少温室气体排放。

dict_mnemonic.text: greenhouse 由 green 加 house 构成，指玻璃温室；greenhouse effect 是温室效应，greenhouse gas 是温室气体；近义词有 glasshouse、hothouse。

root: 由 green（绿色）与 house（房屋）复合而成，核心义为「种植植物的玻璃房」，后由玻璃截留热量的现象引申出温室效应。

sensesIntro.en: Greenhouse means a glass building for plants, a heated flower house, or, as an adjective, heat-trapping.
sensesIntro.cn: greenhouse 指种植植物的玻璃温室、花房，或作定语表示温室效应的。

core.en: A glass house where spring stays.
core.cn: 春天赖着不走的玻璃房。

branches.en: Sunlight fills a glass roof.
branches.cn: 阳光充满玻璃屋顶。

branches.en: Orchids bloom out of season.
branches.cn: 兰花在不当季时开放。

branches.en: A blue planet warms under a clear sky.
branches.cn: 晴朗天空下，蓝色星球在变暖。

branches.en: The building and its flowers share a name.
branches.cn: 建筑与花，共用一个名字。

branches.en: A small glass house becomes a global warning.
branches.cn: 小小的玻璃房，成了全球的警示。

intro.en: Greenhouse forms plurals and common compounds.
intro.cn: greenhouse 构成复数和常见复合词。

latinIntro.en: Greenhouse has no Latin root; both parts are Old English.
latinIntro.cn: greenhouse 没有拉丁词根，两部分都来自古英语。

items.example: The greenhouse effect warms the earth.

items.exampleCN: 他们卖温室栽培的番茄。

definition_zh: 结；绳结；节（速度单位）；打结；（肌肉）紧绷
definition_en: a fastening made by tying a piece of rope or thread into itself, a unit of speed used at sea, or to tie something in this way
core_image: 一根绳在手里绕两圈，两端一抽，鼓出一个死结
scene: 码头的木桩上缠着好几道旧缆绳。 The sailor pulled the wet rope tight and tied a firm knot around the post.
sceneCN: 这里 knot 是「结、绳结」（第 1 个义项：绳子自身系成的扣结），句意是水手把湿绳拉紧，在柱子上系了一个牢结。画面里有码头木桩与旧缆绳。

pos.zh: 名词：结；绳结；节（航速单位）；纠结
动词：打结；使紧绷；打结系住

derivatives.zh: 加 -y 构成，义为「多结的；棘手的」
knot 与 work 合成，义为「编织花饰」
slip 与 knot 合成，义为「活结」
加 -ed 构成，义为「打了结的；纠结的」

senses.title: A fastening tied in rope
senses.definition: a place where rope, string, or hair is tied and pressed together into a lump
senses.definitionCN: 绳、线或头发被系住并挤成一团的地方
senses.example: He made a loop and pulled a knot tight.
senses.exampleCN: 他打出一个环，把结拉紧。
senses.why: The core object is a fastening that holds by friction, made from the material itself.
senses.whyCN: 核心物件是靠摩擦自持的系扣，材料本身就是扣件。

senses.title: A unit of speed at sea
senses.definition: a unit of speed equal to one nautical mile per hour
senses.definitionCN: 等于每小时一海里的速度单位
senses.example: The ferry was doing eighteen knots across the channel.
senses.exampleCN: 渡轮以十八节的速度穿越海峡。
senses.why: Sailors measured speed with a knotted log line, and the number of knots counted became the name of the speed.
senses.whyCN: 水手靠打了结的测速绳测速，数到的结的数目就成了速度之名。

senses.title: To tie something in a knot
senses.definition: to tie or press something into a knot, or to fasten with knots
senses.definitionCN: 把东西系成结，或用结来固定
senses.example: She knotted the scarf around her neck.
senses.exampleCN: 她把围巾在脖子上打了个结。
senses.why: The noun of a fastening turns into the act of making one, as with many object words.
senses.whyCN: 系扣之物转为制出系扣的动作，许多器物词都走这条路。

senses.title: A tight feeling or problem
senses.definition: a tight feeling in the chest or stomach, or a difficult complication in affairs
senses.definitionCN: 胸腹发紧的感觉，或事情纠缠难解的麻烦
senses.example: A knot of anxiety tightened in his stomach.
senses.exampleCN: 他胃里一阵焦虑紧缩。
senses.why: A knot holds fast and will not loosen, which is exactly how a worry or a difficulty feels.
senses.whyCN: 结扣得牢、不肯松开，忧虑与麻烦给人的感觉正是如此。

intro.en: Knot is an old Germanic word with a silent k, and the nautical use grew out of a knotted measuring line.
intro.cn: knot 是古老的日耳曼语词，词首的 k 不发音，航速义来自打了结的测速绳。

items.en: The noun cnotta meant a knot in rope or in hair, and the k was still pronounced.
items.cn: 名词 cnotta 指绳索或头发上的结，那时 k 还发音。

items.en: German Knoten and Dutch knot keep the same noun today, together with the related verb knoten.
items.cn: 德语 Knoten 与荷兰语 knot 至今保留同一名词，以及相关动词 knoten。

items.en: The k at the start stopped sounding, so knot became a homophone of not.
items.cn: 词首 k 不再发音，knot 与 not 成了同音词。

items.en: Sailors counted the knots on a trailing log line, and a speed of one knot meaning one nautical mile per hour grew from it.
items.cn: 水手数拖曳测速绳上的结，一 knot 表示每小时一英里海里的速度由此而来。

items.en: The verb and the figurative senses appear: hair, brows, muscles and worries all knot.
items.cn: 动词与比喻义随后出现：头发、眉毛、肌肉与忧虑都能打结。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers close spellings and relatives; the near-meaning group gathers other fastenings and tangles.
note.cn: 形近组收相近的拼写与同族词；近义组收其他系扣与缠结的说法。

entries.definition: The word plus -y, meaning full of knots or difficult.
entries.definitionCN: 本词加 -y，义为「多结的、棘手的」。

entries.definition: Sounds exactly the same, but it is the negative word.
entries.definitionCN: 读音完全相同，但是否定词。

entries.definition: The related verb from the same Old English tying root.
entries.definitionCN: 同出古英语系扎词根的相关动词。

entries.definition: A confused mass of thread or hair, without a deliberate fastening.
entries.definitionCN: 线与头发乱成一团，并非有意系成。

entries.definition: A knot tied with two loops for decoration or fastening.
entries.definitionCN: 用两个环系成的蝴蝶结。

entries.definition: A bend of rope that returns on itself, one half of a knot.
entries.definitionCN: 绳自身折回的环，常是结的一半。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the silent k, the nautical history of the speed sense, and the phrases the word appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子使用不发音的 k、航速义的海事来历，以及这个词常见的搭配。

normal.en: Knot sounds exactly like not, yet means the opposite of looseness.
normal.cn: knot 与 not 读音相同，意思却与「松」相反。

normal.en: Tie the knot is the everyday idiom for getting married.
normal.cn: tie the knot 是「结婚」的日常习语。

normal.en: At sea, one knot is one nautical mile per hour.
normal.cn: 在海上，一节等于每小时一海里。

normal.en: Knot doubles the t: knotted, knotting.
normal.cn: knot 要双写 t：knotted、knotting。

normal.en: A knotty problem is one full of knots that will not pull apart.
normal.cn: a knotty problem 就是满是解不开的结的难题。

abstract.en: A knot is made of the rope itself: the material holds, yet it is nothing but the material bent back on itself.
abstract.cn: 结由绳自身形成：材料在起作用，而它不过是材料折回自身。

abstract.en: Every knot is a decision that must be untied later, which is why difficulty and rope share a word.
abstract.cn: 每个结都是一项日后必须解开的决定，所以绳子与困难共用一个词。

abstract.en: The speed unit is a knot on a line thrown behind a ship, a number turned into motion.
abstract.cn: 航速单位源自抛在船后的测速绳上的一结，把数字变成了运动。

examples.en: The knot in the shoelace was too tight to pull open.
examples.cn: 鞋带上的结太紧，拉不开。

examples.en: The ship held a steady twelve knots all night.
examples.cn: 那艘船整夜保持十二节的稳定航速。

examples.en: Anxiety knotted his stomach before the interview.
examples.cn: 面试前焦虑让他胃里发紧。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「脑特」——脑子特别绕，像绳子打了个死结

root: 古英语 cnotta「绳结、发结」，源自共同日耳曼语，同源于德语 Knoten、荷兰语 knot；中古英语词首 k 静音；航速「节」源自水手数测速绳上的结；后引申出打结、紧绷、棘手等义。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: a tied fastening, the nautical speed unit, the verb of tying, and the tight feeling or difficulty it resembles.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：系成的结，航速单位，打结的动作，以及结所比喻的紧绷感与难题。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: rope wound on itself and pulled into a hard lump that will not slip.
core.cn: 核心意象：绳子绕回自身，一拉成硬块，不再滑动。

branches.en: THE ROPE LINE: the knot is a fastening made of the rope itself.
branches.cn: 绳索线：结是用绳本身做成的系扣。

branches.en: THE SEA LINE: counted knots on a log line became the unit of speed.
branches.cn: 海上线：测速绳上数出的结成了速度单位。

branches.en: THE ACTION LINE: the object word becomes the verb of tying.
branches.cn: 动作线：器物词转为打结的动词。

branches.en: THE FEELING LINE: what holds fast without loosening becomes worry or trouble.
branches.cn: 感受线：牢住不放的东西成了忧虑或麻烦。

branches.en: THE SOUND LINE: the silent k makes it a twin of not.
branches.cn: 读音线：不发音的 k 让它与 not 成为双胞胎。

intro.en: Knot is a native Germanic word whose family is built by inflection, a few suffixes and compounds.
intro.cn: knot 是本族日耳曼词，其词族由词形变化、少数后缀与合成构成。

latinIntro.en: Knot has no Latin source; the Latin words below are comparisons for the idea of binding.
latinIntro.cn: knot 没有拉丁语来源，下面的拉丁词只是「系缚」这一概念的对照。

items.exampleCN: 给绳子打结只花了几秒。

items.meaningCN: 过去式与过去分词词尾

latinEntries.meaning: to knot, to tie in knots

definition_zh: 水晶；结晶；水晶玻璃
definition_en: a clear mineral, or a solid whose parts form a regular repeating shape
core_image: 一块透明的水晶，棱面把光折成几道
scene: 窗台上有一块透明的水晶，阳光穿过去散成几道光。 The crystal caught the light and threw small rainbows on the wall.
sceneCN: 这里 crystal 指「水晶」（第 1 个义项：透明且带规则棱面的矿物）；句意是水晶接住光，在墙上投出小小的彩虹。

senses.title: Clear mineral
senses.definition: a clear hard mineral used in jewellery and glass
senses.definitionCN: 用于首饰与玻璃的透明坚硬矿物
senses.example: The ring holds a small crystal.
senses.exampleCN: 戒指上镶着一小块水晶。
senses.why: Light passes through it without being swallowed.
senses.whyCN: 光穿过它，没有被吞掉。

senses.title: A regular solid form
senses.definition: a solid whose particles form a regular repeating shape
senses.definitionCN: 微粒排成规则重复形状的固体
senses.example: Salt forms small crystals as it dries.
senses.exampleCN: 盐在变干时结成小晶体。
senses.why: Order appears when a liquid lets go of heat.
senses.whyCN: 液体放下热，秩序就出现了。

senses.title: Fine glassware
senses.definition: glass of high quality, or objects made of it
senses.definitionCN: 高质量玻璃或用水晶制成的器物
senses.example: They drank from tall crystal glasses.
senses.exampleCN: 他们用高脚水晶杯喝酒。
senses.why: Purity of material shows in how it rings.
senses.whyCN: 材料纯不纯，听它敲响就知道。

intro.en: Crystal comes from Greek krystallos, ice, through Latin crystallum and Old French cristal.
intro.cn: crystal 源自希腊语 krystallos（冰），经拉丁语 crystallum 与古法语 cristal 进入英语。

items.en: Krystallos meant ice.
items.cn: krystallos 意为冰。

items.en: It was used for clear rock that looked like frozen water.
items.cn: 它被用来指像冻住的水一样的透明石头。

items.en: Crystallum kept both the ice and the clear stone senses.
items.cn: crystallum 同时保留冰与透明石头两层意思。

items.en: Cristal named clear stone and fine glass.
items.cn: cristal 指透明石头与精细玻璃。

items.en: Crystal meant a clear mineral with flat faces.
items.cn: crystal 指带平面棱的透明矿物。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the crystall- stem or the cr- opening, and the meaning group names other clear solids.
note.cn: 形近组共享 crystall- 词干或 cr- 开头，近义组列出其他透明固体的说法。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with frozen water that never melts and end with a glass that sings.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一块永不融化的冰开始，落到一只会唱的水晶杯。

normal.en: The Greeks called clear stone ice, and the name stuck.
normal.cn: 希腊人把透明石头叫作冰，这名字就留下了。

normal.en: Light goes in white and comes out in colors.
normal.cn: 光白白地进去，出来时带了颜色。

normal.en: Salt and sugar build the same shape, smaller.
normal.cn: 盐和糖也会长出同样的形状，只是更小。

normal.en: Tap a crystal glass and hear how pure it is.
normal.cn: 敲一下水晶杯，就听得出它有多纯。

normal.en: A crystal is order you can hold in your hand.
normal.cn: 水晶是能握在手里的秩序。

abstract.en: Picture a stone with edges sharp as cut glass.
abstract.cn: 想象一块棱边像切玻璃一样锋利的石头。

abstract.en: Picture a thin rainbow lying on a white wall.
abstract.cn: 想象白墙上一道细细的彩虹。

abstract.en: Picture a snowflake that kept its shape all year.
abstract.cn: 想象一片整年都没化掉的雪花。

examples.en: The cave is full of tall crystal columns.
examples.cn: 洞穴里满是高大的水晶柱。

examples.en: These crystals grow slowly in cold water.
examples.cn: 这些晶体在冷水里慢慢长成。

examples.en: She poured the juice into a crystal glass.
examples.cn: 她把果汁倒进一只水晶杯。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 crystal 记成「冻住的光」：希腊人叫它冰（krystallos），透明石头就像冻住的水。

root: 源自希腊语 krystallos（冰），经拉丁语 crystallum 与古法语 cristal 进入英语；本义是像冻住的水一样透明的石头，后指水晶、结晶与水晶玻璃。

sensesIntro.en: From a clear mineral, to a regular solid form, to fine glass that rings.
sensesIntro.cn: 从透明矿物，到规则的固体形态，再到敲之有声的精细玻璃。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a clear stone splitting sunlight into colors.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块透明石头把阳光分成几种颜色。

branches.en: The stone is valued because light can cross it.
branches.cn: 这块石头珍贵，是因为光能穿过它。

branches.en: Small particles line up and repeat the same shape.
branches.cn: 小颗粒排好队，一遍遍重复同一形状。

branches.en: Fine glass carries the same name in a cup.
branches.cn: 精细玻璃做成杯子，也叫这个名字。

branches.en: The big stone and the small grain share one order.
branches.cn: 大石头与小颗粒共享同一种秩序。

branches.en: Clear stone and clear glass both let light speak.
branches.cn: 透明石头与透明玻璃都让光说话。

intro.en: Crystal grows a family of words for clear stone, regular shapes, and the act of forming them.
intro.cn: crystal 长出一族词，关于透明石头、规则形状以及形成它们的过程。

latinIntro.en: The Greek krystallos, ice, is the root under crystal and crystalline.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 krystallos（冰）是 crystal 与 crystalline 背后的根。

items.example: The crystal is cut with many faces.
items.exampleCN: 这块水晶切出很多棱面。

items.example: The rock has a crystalline structure.
Sugar will crystallize as it cools.
The lake water is crystal clear.

items.meaning: a glass ball used by fortune tellers
items.example: She looked into a crystal ball.

items.meaning: clear quartz in its natural form
items.example: Rock crystal was once prized as ice.

definition_zh: 经历；经受；承受；（医）接受（治疗、手术）
definition_en: to go through something difficult or a process that changes you
core_image: 一个人低头走进一条昏暗的通道，出来时已经不同了
scene: 手术室外的长椅上，家属们安静地等着，护士说病人正在里面接受一次大手术。 She had to undergo two operations in one year.
sceneCN: 这里 undergo 是「接受（手术）」（第 3 个义项：承受某种过程）；句意为她一年里不得不接受两次手术。低头走进昏暗通道，出来时已不同，正是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 现在分词，义为「正在经历」

senses.title: To go through an experience
senses.definition: to pass through a period or an event that acts on you
senses.definitionCN: 穿过一段时期或一件事，并受其作用
senses.example: The town underwent great changes in the war.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城在战争中经历了巨大变化。
senses.why: Under means beneath and go means move, so to undergo is to pass beneath a weight and come out the other side.
senses.whyCN: under 意为在其下，go 意为行进，合起来就是从那重压底下穿过、再从另一头出来。

senses.title: To be subjected to a process
senses.definition: to be put through a process such as testing or repair
senses.definitionCN: 被放入检查、修理之类的流程中
senses.example: Every engine undergoes a final check.
senses.exampleCN: 每台发动机都要经过最后检查。
senses.why: A process laid over you is a weight over you, and the two images meet.
senses.whyCN: 加在你身上的一套流程就是压在你身上的一重压，两个意象在此汇合。

senses.title: To receive medical treatment
senses.definition: to have a treatment performed on one’s body
senses.definitionCN: 让人在自己身体上施行某项治疗
senses.example: He underwent a heart operation last spring.
senses.exampleCN: 去年春天他接受了一次心脏手术。
senses.why: In medicine the word keeps the sense of letting something heavy pass over the body.
senses.whyCN: 在医学里，这个词保留了「让沉重之物从身体上经过」的意思。

senses.title: To endure hardship or suffering
senses.definition: to bear pain or loss over a period of time
senses.definitionCN: 在一段时间里承受疼痛或损失
senses.example: The villagers underwent years of shortage.
senses.exampleCN: 村民们过了好几年短缺的日子。
senses.why: Hardship is a weight that stays on for a long time, and the word names the bearing of it.
senses.whyCN: 艰难是长时间压着的一副重量，这个词指的正是把它担过去。

senses.title: To suffer a change of state
senses.definition: of a thing, to pass into a different state through a process
senses.definitionCN: 指某物经由过程转入另一种状态
senses.example: The metal undergoes expansion when heated.
senses.exampleCN: 金属受热时会发生膨胀。
senses.why: Whatever the process is, the subject comes out different, which is why the word suits changes.
senses.whyCN: 不论过程为何，主体走过之后都会变样，所以它特别适合说变化。

intro.en: The word is an English compound of under and go, first recorded in Old English.
intro.cn: 这个词是 under 与 go 的英语复合词，最早见于古英语。

items.en: Undergan means to undergo or to undertake, built from under and gan, to go.
items.cn: undergān 意为承受或着手，由 under 与 gān（走）构成。

items.en: The prefix under carried the idea of coming under something.
items.cn: 前缀 under 带着「进到某物之下」的意思。

items.en: Middle English undergon keeps the sense of passing through hardship.
items.cn: 中古英语 undergon 保留「穿过艰难」之义。

items.en: The past forms underwent and undergone settle into their modern spelling.
items.cn: 过去式与过去分词定型为 underwent 与 undergone。

items.en: Medical usage for treatment grows in the nineteenth and twentieth centuries.
items.cn: 表示「接受治疗」的医学用法在十九、二十世纪兴盛。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers under- compounds, and the near-meaning group collects verbs of experiencing.
note.cn: 形近组汇集 under- 复合词，近义组汇集表示经历的动词。

entries.definition: to take on a duty or task
to lie beneath as a cause

normalIntro.en: Under plus go: you go beneath a thing and come out on the far side.
normalIntro.cn: under 加 go：从一件东西底下走过去，再从另一头出来。

normal.en: Undergo is irregular: underwent today, undergone in the past participle.
normal.cn: undergo 不规则：过去式 underwent，过去分词 undergone。

normal.en: The word almost always takes an article with a process, as in undergo an operation.
normal.cn: 这个词接过程名词时通常带冠词，如 undergo an operation。

normal.en: Undertake takes on a duty, while undergo receives an experience.
normal.cn: undertake 是主动承担，undergo 是被动承受。

normal.en: Hospitals use it constantly: patients undergo tests, scans, and surgery.
normal.cn: 医院里用得极多：病人 undergo 检查、扫描、手术。

normal.en: Undergo change is the standard formal way to say something was altered.
normal.cn: undergo change 是表示「发生了变化」的正式说法。

abstract.en: Step down into a dim passage and keep walking.
abstract.cn: 低头走进一条昏暗的通道，一直往前走。

abstract.en: Feel the walls close while your own shape changes.
abstract.cn: 感觉两侧墙收拢，而你自己的形状在变。

abstract.en: Come out at the other end wearing that change.
abstract.cn: 从另一头出来时，已经带着那层变化。

examples.en: The bridge will undergo repairs this summer.
examples.cn: 这座桥今年夏天将进行维修。

examples.en: Patients must undergo a full examination first.
examples.cn: 病人必须先接受全面检查。

examples.en: The old factory underwent a complete change of use.
examples.cn: 那座旧厂房经历了彻底的用途改变。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安得够」——能不能安得够稳，只看你经不经得住这一程。

root: 古英语 under（在下）+ gān（走），undergān 意为承受、着手；过去式 underwent，过去分词 undergone

sensesIntro.en: In every sense the subject passes beneath something, an event, a process, an operation, or hardship.
sensesIntro.cn: 在每一个义项里，主体都从某样东西底下经过：一件事、一套流程、一次手术，或一段艰难。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: walking through a dim passage and changing inside it.
core.cn: 核心意象：穿过昏暗通道，在里面被改变。

branches.en: The change branch: events and heat that alter the subject.
branches.cn: 变化分支：改变主体的事件与热。

branches.en: The process branch: checks and repairs laid over a thing.
branches.cn: 流程分支：加在物上的检查与修理。

branches.en: The medical branch: operations and scans on the body.
branches.cn: 医学分支：在身体上做的手术与扫描。

branches.en: The hardship branch: years of shortage borne quietly.
branches.cn: 艰难分支：默默承受的多年短缺。

branches.en: The common sense of living through a period.
branches.cn: 常用义：度过一段时期。

intro.en: Two Old English pieces joined: a preposition of position and a verb of moving.
intro.cn: 两块古英语部件拼合：一个方位介词与一个走动的动词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source, so the Latin list stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 此词没有拉丁语来源，故拉丁同源词一栏留空。

items.exampleCN: 信任是这笔交易的基础。

definition_zh: 反复地；一再地
definition_en: many times, one after another, often in a way that is noticeable or annoying
core_image: 同一只手一次又一次按下同一个按钮，指示灯一遍遍亮起
scene: 机器报警后，值班员反复检查同一处接口，直到确认没有问题。 The operator repeatedly checked the same connection until it was safe.
sceneCN: 这里 repeatedly 是「反复地」（第 1 个义项：同一动作一次又一次发生）；句意：操作员反复检查同一处接口，直到确认安全。

senses.title: Many times in succession
senses.definition: on many occasions, one after another
senses.definitionCN: 一次又一次地，在同一件事上多次发生
senses.example: She repeatedly asked for the file to be sent again.
senses.exampleCN: 她反复要求把文件再发一次。
senses.why: The adverb is simply repeated plus -ly, so its first job is to mark an action that happens over and over.
senses.whyCN: 这个副词就是 repeated 加 -ly，所以首要功能是标记「一遍又一遍发生」的动作。

senses.title: With persistent recurrence
senses.definition: again and again in a way that continues despite efforts to stop it
senses.definitionCN: 尽管有人试图阻止，仍然一次又一次地持续出现
senses.example: The alarm went off repeatedly during the night.
senses.exampleCN: 警报在夜里一再响起。
senses.why: Repeated events can become a pattern that resists stopping, which adds a tone of persistence or irritation.
senses.whyCN: 反复出现的事件会形成难以制止的模式，于是带上了「执拗、令人烦躁」的语气。

intro.en: Repeatedly is an English formation from repeated, itself repeat plus -ed, with the adverb ending -ly added on top.
intro.cn: repeatedly 是英语内部构成的词：repeat 加 -ed 成 repeated，再加副词词尾 -ly。

items.en: The stem goes back to repetere, to seek again, from re- and petere.
items.cn: 词干可上溯到 repetere（再次寻求），由 re- 与 petere 构成。

items.en: Old French repeter brings the verb into English as repeat.
items.cn: 古法语 repeter 把该动词带入英语，成为 repeat。

items.en: Middle English repeat gains the past participle repeated.
items.cn: 中古英语 repeat 产生过去分词 repeated。

items.en: The adjective repeated comes to mean done or said over and over.
items.cn: 形容词 repeated 逐渐表示「反复做过或说过的」。

items.en: Adding -ly creates repeatedly, the adverb of recurrent action.
items.cn: 再加 -ly 构成 repeatedly，表示反复动作的副词。

items.en: Today the word often signals frequency that is hard to ignore.
items.cn: 如今这个词常暗示那种难以忽视的高频反复。

note.en: Repeatedly is the adverb of frequency built on repeat, and it sits close to other words for things that keep happening.
note.cn: repeatedly 是由 repeat 构成的频率副词，与其它表示「不断发生」的词相邻。

entries.definition: repeatedly over a period, with short breaks
in a way that continues firmly despite difficulty

normalIntro.en: Repeatedly is transparent: repeat plus -ed plus -ly, so the spelling itself tells you it means done again and again.
normalIntro.cn: repeatedly 的构词很透明：repeat 加 -ed 再加 -ly，拼写本身就在说「一遍又一遍地做」。

normal.en: Strip the endings and you find repeat, the verb that started the whole family.
normal.cn: 去掉词尾就看到 repeat，整个词族都从这个动词开始。

normal.en: The -ed makes it a description, and -ly turns that description into a way of acting.
normal.cn: -ed 使它成为描述，-ly 再把描述变成动作的方式。

normal.en: The long string of letters matches the long string of repetitions.
normal.cn: 这一长串字母，正对应一长串重复。

normal.en: Compare repeated and repeatedly: one describes, the other tells how often.
normal.cn: 对比 repeated 与 repeatedly：一个作描述，一个说明频率。

normal.en: Pair it with verbs like ask, warn, and fail to see the pattern quickly.
normal.cn: 把它和 ask、warn、fail 等动词搭配，很快就能看出用法模式。

abstract.en: Picture a lift button glowing again and again under the same thumb.
abstract.cn: 想象同一根拇指下，电梯按钮一次又一次亮起。

abstract.en: Imagine a phone ringing at the same minute every morning.
abstract.cn: 想象电话每天早晨同一分钟响起。

abstract.en: Think of a wave returning to the same line on the sand.
abstract.cn: 想象海浪一次次回到沙滩上的同一条线。

examples.en: He repeatedly warned them about the risk.
examples.cn: 他一再警告他们注意风险。

examples.en: The experiment failed repeatedly before it worked.
examples.cn: 实验在成功之前反复失败。

examples.en: She was repeatedly interrupted during the interview.
examples.cn: 采访中她屡次被打断。

dict_mnemonic.text: repeat（重复）+ -ed + -ly（地）＝反复地；这是拆词联想，不是谐音。

root: repeat（重复，源自拉丁语 repetere）+ 形容词词尾 -ed + 副词词尾 -ly，表示「以反复的方式」。

sensesIntro.en: The adverb marks frequency first, and then takes on the extra colour of persistence when the repetition will not stop.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个副词首先标记频率，当重复停不下来时，又添上「执拗持续」的色彩。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the same action pressed out again and again.
core.cn: 核心意象：同一个动作被一遍又一遍地按出来。

branches.en: The plain sense counts occasions: once, twice, many times.
branches.cn: 基本义是在数次数：一次、两次、很多次。

branches.en: When the count will not stop, the word gains a tone of persistence.
branches.cn: 当次数停不下来时，这个词就带上执拗持续的语气。

branches.en: Repetition is both a frequency and a pattern that resists stopping.
branches.cn: 重复既是频率，也是难以打断的模式。

branches.en: In neutral reports the word simply records how often something happened.
branches.cn: 在中性叙述里，这个词只记录事情发生了多少次。

branches.en: In complaints the same word signals that the recurrence has become a burden.
branches.cn: 在抱怨中，同一个词暗示这种反复已经成为负担。

intro.en: Repeatedly is built entirely with English endings on a Latin verb stem.
intro.cn: repeatedly 完全是在拉丁动词词干上叠加英语词尾构成的。

latinIntro.en: The Latin verb repetere means to seek again, and its stem repeat carries the meaning into English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁动词 repetere 意为「再次寻求」，其词干 repeat 把意思带入英语。

items.exampleCN: re- 出现在动词 repeat 开头。

items.example: Petere supplies the stem of repeat.
items.exampleCN: petere 提供 repeat 的词干。

items.example: Repetere is the Latin source of repeat.
items.exampleCN: repetere 是 repeat 的拉丁语来源。

items.example: Repeat is the base of repeatedly.
items.exampleCN: repeat 是 repeatedly 的基础词。

items.example: The suffix -ly forms adverbs like repeatedly.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ly 构成 repeatedly 这类副词。

definition_zh: 合成的；人造的；虚假的
definition_en: made by chemical processes rather than taken from nature
core_image: 实验室里的烧瓶被倒出透明纤维，织成一块布
scene: 这件外套用的是合成纤维。 This jacket is made of synthetic fibres.
sceneCN: 这里 synthetic 是「合成的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这件外套用的是合成纤维。

senses.title: Made by chemical synthesis
senses.definition: produced by combining substances in a lab
senses.definitionCN: 在实验室中由物质组合而成
senses.example: This jacket is made of synthetic fibres.
senses.exampleCN: 这件外套用的是合成纤维。
senses.why: The Greek root means putting things together, so a lab-made material is one assembled from parts.
senses.whyCN: 希腊词根意为把东西放在一起，因此实验室制造的材料是由部分组装而成。

senses.title: Not genuine in feeling
senses.definition: insincere, as if manufactured
senses.definitionCN: 不真诚的，仿佛人工制造
senses.example: He answered with a synthetic smile.
senses.exampleCN: 他带着假笑回答。
senses.why: If a material can be manufactured, so can an emotion that looks real but is not.
senses.whyCN: 材料可以制造，看起来真实却并非真实的情感也可以。

intro.en: Synthetic comes from Greek synthetikos, skilled at putting together.
intro.cn: synthetic 源自希腊语 synthetikos，意为善于组合。

items.en: Synthesis meant a putting together.
items.cn: synthesis 意为放在一起。

items.en: Tithenai meant to place.
items.cn: tithenai 意为放置。

items.en: Modern Latin syntheticus kept the combining sense.
items.cn: 近代拉丁语 syntheticus 保留组合之义。

items.en: Synthetic entered chemistry for lab-made compounds.
items.cn: synthetic 进入化学领域，指实验室制造的化合物。

items.en: Synthetic widened to anything artificial or insincere.
items.cn: synthetic 扩展到任何人工或虚假之物。

note.en: Synthetic is compared with look-alike words and with words for artificial things.
note.cn: 把 synthetic 与形近词以及表示人造的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Synthetic means assembled by human hands instead of grown by nature.
normalIntro.cn: synthetic 指由人手工合成，而非自然生长。

normal.en: This jacket is made of synthetic fibres.
normal.cn: 这件外套用的是合成纤维。

normal.en: Synthetic rubber replaced natural rubber in tyres.
normal.cn: 合成橡胶在轮胎中取代了天然橡胶。

normal.en: The fabric is cheap because it is synthetic.
normal.cn: 这种布料便宜，因为是合成的。

normal.en: He answered with a synthetic smile.
normal.cn: 他带着假笑回答。

normal.en: The drug is synthetic but effective.
normal.cn: 这种药是合成的，但很有效。

abstract.en: Synthetic is nature rewritten in a laboratory hand.
abstract.cn: 合成是用实验室的手重写自然。

abstract.en: What is synthetic can be perfect and still feel wrong.
abstract.cn: 合成的可以完美，却仍让人觉得不对。

abstract.en: We build materials, and sometimes we build our smiles.
abstract.cn: 我们制造材料，有时也制造笑容。

examples.en: This jacket is made of synthetic fibres.
examples.cn: 这件外套用的是合成纤维。

examples.en: Synthetic rubber replaced natural rubber in tyres.
examples.cn: 合成橡胶在轮胎中取代了天然橡胶。

examples.en: He answered with a synthetic smile.
examples.cn: 他带着假笑回答。

dict_mnemonic.note: 构词记忆 · syn-（一起）+ thet（放置）+ -ic
dict_mnemonic.text: syn- 表示一起，thet 表示放置，-ic 为形容词词尾；把物质放在一起造出来的，就是「合成的」。

root: 来自希腊语 synthetikos（善于组合），由 syn（一起）与 tithenai（放置）构成。

sensesIntro.en: Synthetic means made by chemical combination, and by extension not genuine.
sensesIntro.cn: synthetic 表示化学合成的，引申为不真诚的。

core.en: Parts assembled by hand into something that looks natural.
core.cn: 各部分被手工组装成看似自然之物。

branches.en: This jacket is made of synthetic fibres.
branches.cn: 这件外套用的是合成纤维。

branches.en: Synthetic rubber replaced natural rubber in tyres.
branches.cn: 合成橡胶在轮胎中取代了天然橡胶。

branches.en: The drug is synthetic but effective.
branches.cn: 这种药是合成的，但很有效。

branches.en: He answered with a synthetic smile.
branches.cn: 他带着假笑回答。

branches.en: What is synthetic can imitate but not belong.
branches.cn: 合成之物能模仿，却无法归属于自然。

intro.en: Synthetic forms synthesis, synthesize and synthetically.
intro.cn: synthetic 可构成 synthesis、synthesize 与 synthetically。

latinIntro.en: Synthetic is Greek; Latin componere, to put together, gives compose.
latinIntro.cn: synthetic 源自希腊语；拉丁语 componere（放在一起）衍生出 compose。

items.example: The essay is a synthesis of ideas.
items.exampleCN: 这篇文章是各种观点的综合。
这种化合物是人工合成的。

definition_zh: 投降；放弃；交出
definition_en: to stop fighting and give up, or to hand something over
core_image: 士兵放下武器，双手举过头顶
scene: 被围困的士兵最终选择投降。 The surrounded soldiers finally chose to surrender.
sceneCN: 这里 surrender 是「投降」（第 1 个义项）；句意：被围困的士兵最终选择投降。

senses.title: To stop fighting
senses.definition: to admit defeat and stop fighting
senses.definitionCN: 承认失败并停止战斗
senses.example: The surrounded soldiers finally chose to surrender.
senses.exampleCN: 被围困的士兵最终选择投降。
senses.why: This is the military core sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是军事上的核心义项。

senses.title: To give something up
senses.definition: to hand over something one has
senses.definitionCN: 交出自己所拥有的东西
senses.example: They surrendered their passports at the border.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在边境交出了护照。
senses.why: Here the word means handing over rather than military defeat.
senses.whyCN: 这里指交出而非军事失败。

senses.title: To yield to a feeling
senses.definition: to stop resisting an emotion or desire
senses.definitionCN: 不再抵抗某种情感或欲望
senses.example: She surrendered to a wave of tiredness.
senses.exampleCN: 她屈服于一阵疲倦。
senses.why: The sense extends from battle to inner struggle.
senses.whyCN: 该义从战斗延伸到内心挣扎。

intro.en: Surrender means to give back, from French sur and rendre.
intro.cn: surrender 意为交还，来自法语的 sur 与 rendre。

items.en: Reddere meant to give back.
items.cn: reddere 意为交还。

items.en: Super meant over.
items.cn: super 意为在上。

items.en: Surrendre meant to give up.
items.cn: surrendre 意为交出。

items.en: Surrender meant to hand over.
items.cn: surrender 意为交出。

items.en: Surrender became the standard word for giving up a fight.
items.cn: surrender 成为表示停止战斗的标准词。

note.en: Surrender is compared with look-alike sur- words and with words for yielding.
note.cn: 把 surrender 与形近的 sur- 词以及表示屈服的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Surrender is the act of handing over what one held.
normalIntro.cn: surrender 是交出自己所持之物的动作。

abstract.en: Surrender is a decision made when fighting no longer serves life.
abstract.cn: 投降是当战斗不再服务于生命时作出的决定。

abstract.en: To surrender something can be strength rather than weakness.
abstract.cn: 交出某物可以是力量而非软弱。

abstract.en: The word gives back what was taken, in name and in deed.
abstract.cn: 这个词在名与实上把取走的东西交还。

sensesIntro.en: Surrender means to stop fighting, hand something over, or yield to a feeling.
sensesIntro.cn: surrender 指停止战斗、交出某物，或屈服于某种情感。

core.en: Opening the hand and giving up what was held.
core.cn: 张开手，放弃所持之物。

branches.en: Battle and belongings can both be surrendered.
branches.cn: 战斗与财物都可以被交出。

intro.en: Surrender forms surrendered, surrendering, and surrenderer.
intro.cn: surrender 可构成 surrendered、surrendering 与 surrenderer。

latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 reddere（交还）是最深层的词根。
